posts.body_html: I know with purps it's not recommended to cut off old pitchers from last season but for this hybrid has anyone had any issues with this? I have a couple half dead pitchers from last season still on it and I want to clear it out so the rhizome gets more light if possible.
posts.body_text: I know with purps it's not recommended to cut off old pitchers from last season but for this hybrid has anyone had any issues with this? I have a couple half dead pitchers from last season still on it and I want to clear it out so the rhizome gets more light if possible.

posts.body_html: Cutting off decent old pitchers generally results in shorter growth. Leucophyllas prefer light to the rhizome in summer, but there's no advantage in getting light to the growth points in spring in my experience.
